title: Enterprise Bank & Trust Enhances Texas Leadership with Dallas and Metroplex Central Executive Promotions
summary: EB&T is pleased to announce the promotions of Jason Ebanks to Market President - Dallas and A.J. Fazalbhai to Market President - Metroplex Central.
body_markdown:
Enterprise Bank & Trust, the banking subsidiary of Enterprise Financial Services Corp (NASDAQ: EFSC), is pleased to announce the promotions of Jason Ebanks to Market President - Dallas and A.J. Fazalbhai to Market President - Metroplex Central.


These advancements reflect an investment in the proven leadership each has demonstrated in the Dallas-Fort Worth region in support of the bank’s steady growth in Texas markets. Ebanks and Fazalbhai continue to lead their respective teams in executing strategies developed in collaboration with regional leadership including David Williams, Vice Chairman, Texas, to increase Enterprise’s presence and impact throughout the state.


“North Texas represents an important part of Enterprise’s future, and strong local leadership remains critical to realizing the opportunity we have here,” said Jeff Carson, Enterprise President, Kansas City & Texas region. “We are extremely fortunate to have two energetic and thoughtful leaders of Jason’s and A.J.’s caliber representing our commitment to serving this region and helping clients succeed.”


Ebanks uses more than 15 years of professional experience, gained entirely in Dallas, to help clients reach their financial goals. He proved instrumental in expanding the reach of Enterprise’s unique commercial lending model in Texas since joining the bank in 2022, managing complex loan portfolios and developing custom lending solutions and financial strategies.


Leveraging deep ties to the local business community, Fazalbhai brings 25 years of banking experience to his newest role. He came to the bank in 2025 and made an immediate impact through strategic discipline and consistent business development progress in the commercial banking segment.


Enterprise entered the state of Texas in 2022 and continues to expand its commercial lending footprint and business portfolio serving a broad range of markets.
